description: This file provides utility functions to extract probability metrics from transcription results in various formats produced by different speech-to-text (STT) services, including Whisper, GPT-4o, and Deepgram. It defines functions to handle specific formats and compute confidence probabilities.

methods.name: Optional[float] extract_whisper_probability(frame: TranscriptionFrame)
methods.description: Extracts a probability value from a TranscriptionFrame object based on Whisper's verbose_json segment data, converting avg_logprob to a probability between 0 and 1.

methods.name: Optional[float] extract_openai_gpt4o_probability(frame: TranscriptionFrame)
methods.description: Calculates a probability from a TranscriptionFrame object containing GPT-4o-transcribe logprobs, averaging the log probabilities and converting to a probability.

methods.name: Optional[float] extract_deepgram_probability(frame: TranscriptionFrame)
methods.description: Extracts a confidence metric from a Deepgram TranscriptionFrame, preferring alternative confidences or computing an average from word confidences when available.
